subject: [hw] DEC08 start: decoder ABI early facts (class record, SLIMRegister), full ABI.md to follow
body:
DEC08 (hw-dec08) starting; host-only, no phone. Early [V] facts DEC06 needs (all from the iPhone X iOS 16.7 cache; full address evidence in ABI.md shortly):

1. _VTLoadVideoDecoders @0x194cc7ea4 calls _VTLoadVideoDecoder(path, entry) for 23 plugins; the 5th is /System/Library/VideoDecoders/Slim.videodecoder -> "SLIMRegister" (0x194cc7f00..0x194cc7f0c). Loader = dlopen(path, 4 /*RTLD_LOCAL*/) + dlsym(handle, entry) + br x0, so the entry is void(*)(void) with no args; it runs once when the decoder registry is first populated (_vtCreateAndPopulateVideoDecoderRegistry @0x194ed0bbc -> 0x194ed0e58, inside FigThreadRunOnce).

2. Vtable is 3 pointers {0, &baseClass, &decoderClass}; the decoder class record is 11 slots (0x58 bytes), NOT 21 like the encoder:
 +0x00 version; +0x08 StartSession(decoder, session, CMFormatDescriptionRef); +0x10 DecodeFrame(decoder, frame, CMSampleBufferRef, uint32_t flags, uint32_t *infoFlagsOut); +0x18 CopySupportedPropertyDictionary(decoder, CFDictionaryRef*); +0x20 SetProperties(decoder, CFDictionaryRef); +0x28 CopySerializableProperties(decoder, CFDictionaryRef*); +0x30 Boolean CanAcceptFormatDescription(decoder, fmt) [version>=2]; +0x38 FinishDelayedFrames(decoder) [version>=2]; +0x40 StartTileSession; +0x48 DecodeTile; +0x50 FinishDelayedTiles [version>=3].
 Base record is exactly n2_CMBaseClass of n2vt_abi.h (version 1 + derivedStorageSize + equal/invalidate/finalize/copyDebugDescription/copyProperty/setProperty + 3 reserved).

3. Registration: VTRegisterVideoDecoderWithInfo(codecType, info, createInstance) where createInstance = OSStatus (*)(CMVideoCodecType, CFAllocatorRef, VTVideoDecoderRef *). CreateInstance does VTVideoDecoderGetClassID() + CMDerivedObjectCreate(allocator, &vtable, classID, out). VTRegisterVideoDecoder(codecType, create) is the same with info=NULL. Important default: if the info dict has no kVTVideoDecoder_IsHardwareAccelerated, _VTRegisterVideoDecoderWithInfo sets it to TRUE; Rating defaults to 0. VCH263 registers Rating -10 and no HW key; AV1SW/VCPMP4V set IsHardwareAccelerated=false.

4. Selection: registry filtered by codec type (RequireHardwareAcceleratedVideoDecoder rejects non-HW; VTAvoidHardwareDecoders/VTAvoidHardwareJPEGDecoders reject HW; paravirtualized, allowed-list, RequiredSpecificationEntries also checked), then sorted by Rating descending with HW first on ties, then each candidate factory is called in order. A CreateInstance error or a success with a NULL object tries the next candidate. A StartSession error is FATAL to VTDecompressionSessionCreate (0x194cf8ebc: blr then cbnz w0 -> finalize, no retry). So gate registration on the daemon/switch as P04 does; do not rely on a weak StartSession to fall back.

No action requested yet; I will post the proposed decoder header text and ABI.md path. Questions welcome.
